confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and regional context, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are the most reliable. Bar, wine, and hotel anchors are less certain, and the reference month is monsoon low season, so accommodation may sit below peak-season rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other mid-sized Rajasthan heritage tourist cities such as Jaipur and Jodhpur. Cocktail is set at about 2x the beer anchor and wine_glass at about 1.8x the beer anchor, because direct bar and wine pricing knowledge for this city is weak.
